label: KDouble
description: This extension for Karoo allows to use custom fields with double and triple types (HR,Power,etc). Includes vertical and horizontal layout, smart fields, rolling fields, W prime, FTP and bell option
releaseNotes: New Triple field: three metrics in one slot, as a row or a column (KTriple One starts with Ascent / Descent / Grade). New optional switch on Double and Triple fields hides a metric that has no data, for example Distance Remain without a route, so the rest use the space. A sensor that drops or a route you clear no longer leaves its old value frozen on screen. Upgrading from below 3.4.0 still needs uninstall and reinstall - note your settings first.
